data.name: MedEffectsHUD
data.teaser: Tired of opening your profile every 10 seconds to check your buffs? No idea how much time is left on your painkiller? Zagustin wore off mid-fight and you didn't even notice? Missed the moment your endurance stim expired? Never again.
data.description:
A compact in-raid HUD overlay — all active buffs and debuffs right on your screen, with timers and values.

What it shows

  • All buffs from stimulators, meds, and skills — with countdown timers
  • All debuffs — bleedings, fractures, tremor, pain — nothing slips by
  • Time remaining for every effect
  • Blinking warning when a buff is about to expire
  • Works on every localizations.

Fully customizable

  • ICONS! Can customise icons via chanching it in folder of mod. (u can change them if u want to on this folder BepInEx\plugins\MedEffectsHUD\icons - there is some overridding icons in positive and negative buffs so watch them too. Size of icons needs to be 32x32 and PNG ONLY! DO NOT RENAME ICON NAMES!)
  • Colors for buff names, debuff names, values, and timers — all configurable
  • 3 layout modes: side-by-side columns or stacked list, Icons only
  • Auto-abbreviated long names, sorted by time remaining
  • Blacklist — hide effects you don’t care about
  • Position, size, font, transparency — make it yours
  • Notification: new debuffs or expiring buffs on middle of the screen (configurable)

Toggle HUD with F8 by default (configurable).

Installation

  1. Download the MedEffectsHUD.zip
  2. Extract it into the root folder of your SPT installation
  3. Folders merge automatically — if prompted to overwrite, say yes
  4. Launch the game — press F8 to toggle the HUD

Gallery

  • https://postimg.cc/wR5vj8qm
  • https://postimg.cc/kB4DhBNQ

Known Issues

  • Couple of icons are still missing - dont have time to check all of them so would be pleasant from your side to tell witch of them

I made it for myself because I was tired of TAB’ing to buffs and checking timers — don’t hit me hard, it’s my first mod to share with you.

All the thanks to the SPT Team and community. Share, use and change whatever you want — free to use.

Suggestions via Discord or GitHub Issues

versions.description:
UNINSTALL PREVIOUS VERSION AND DELETE NEXT FILES:
MedEffectsHUD in folders
- BepInEx\plugins -> MedEffectsHUD.dll
-  BepInEx\plugins\MedEffectsHUD -> all folder

New placement for mod in  BepInEx\plugins\MedEffectsHUD\MedEffectsHUD.dll
Some structural changes for auto install and fix ZIP

BugFixes:

- Fixed HUD background not loading from config after map change.
- Added missing icons (Wound, FreshWound, HandsTremor, Frostbite)

Some of Icons was rechanged and cleaned. Better to uninstall your version and download again. Or acept all replacements in installation.

Any suggestions, bugs and other things write in comments, discord or github (links in description of mod)

Icons are HERE!

New features:
 - ICONS - 3 visual setups: TextOnly, IconAndText, IconOnly 
 -  70+ icons for buffs/debuffs and skills (u can change them if u want to on this folder BepInEx\plugins\MedEffectsHUD\icons - there is some overridding icons in positive and negative buffs so watch them too. Size of icons needs to be 32x32 and PNG ONLY! DO NOT RENAME ICON NAMES!)
- Different icons on same buff depends on is it positive or negative. Can be changed manualy on icons folder
- IconOnly Grid — short and compact version of buffs - now u can see it more clearly. Configurable
- Notifications: at the start of negative buff or at the end of positive buff u will get an icon of that buff - just to make sure u will see "pain or bleed on you or painkiller is went off - Configurable
- Default game font "Bender", or whatever installed on your PC. Configurable
- Change the HUD height. Auto or manualy (via config)
- Change icon size in bars or notifications.

BugFix: buff timer not updating on stims/buff reapplication

- When reusing a stim while previous one is still active, the timer
was showing old remaining time instead of resetting. Fixed

Also allows buffs with different values to show as separate lines
instead of merging into one.
